description: Your org's incidents: what `threatcrush investigate --raise`, the daemon (critical detections) and people raised to humans. Filter by host and explicit since timestamp; only teams you can see. Session token or tc_agent_ key.

host.description: Filter incidents whose recorded host contains this value (for example dev2)

org_id.description: Organization id (default: the key's org, or your first org)

since.description: Only incidents last seen at or after this timestamp; pass an explicit timezone when interpreting phrases such as last night

status.description: Comma list of open, acknowledged, resolved, or all (default all)

name: incidents_list
title: List incidents
